title: Step 6 - Cleaning Text Data: Removing Punctuation for NLP and Classification

cues.en: -: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So, we are still trying as hard as we can to simplify the corpus in order to reduce the future sparse matrix of features as much as possible.
cues.zh: 仍在盡力簡化 corpus，盡可能縮小未來稀疏特徵矩陣。

cues.en: And so far, we put all the words in lower cases, we removed all the numbers and removed all the punctuation.
cues.zh: 到目前轉小寫、去數字、去標點。

cues.en: And in today's tutorial, we are going to remove all the non-relevant words of our reviews.
cues.zh: 今天移除評論所有無關詞。

cues.en: So what is a non-relevant word?
cues.zh: 什麼是無關詞？

cues.en: It's, for example, this word here.
cues.zh: 例如這裡的 this。

cues.en: Indeed if we know that this first review, "Wow, love this place" is a positive review, it's not thanks to "this" word, it's of course thanks to the loved word.
cues.zh: 知道「Wow, loved this place」正面，不是因 this，而是 loved。

cues.en: So that means that this word here is not a relevant word.
cues.zh: 所以 this 無關。

cues.en: And so, it's totally non-relevant for us and not useful to include it in the future sparse matrix that will be nothing else than the matrix of features and the outcome whether the review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 對我們完全無用，不必納入未來由特徵矩陣及正負結果構成的模型。

cues.en: So, that's what we'll do in this tutorial.
cues.zh: 這堂就做這件事。

cues.en: We will remove all these non-relevant words and we will update our purpose of reviews by removing all these words.
cues.zh: 移除全部無關詞，更新 corpus。

cues.en: All right, so same as before, very simply, we take this line, copy and paste it below.
cues.zh: 如之前，複製這行貼下來。

cues.en: And in this line we're going to replace remove punctuation by remove words.
cues.zh: removePunctuation 換 removeWords。

cues.en: But that's not all.
cues.zh: 還不只。

cues.en: This time, it's not as simple as before.
cues.zh: 這次沒之前那麼簡單。

cues.en: We need to add something, which is a something that will specify which words we want to remove.
cues.zh: 要加東西，指定哪些詞要移除。

cues.en: And actually there is a built in list of non-relevant words that is called stop words.
cues.zh: 其實有內建無關詞清單，叫 stopwords。

cues.en: And that basically contains all the non-relevant words like this, all other articles, prepositions like and, or.
cues.zh: 基本包含 this、其他冠詞，還有 and、or 等連接詞。

cues.en: Well, you know, all these words that don't help the machine learning algorithm figure out if the review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 這些無助演算法判斷正負。

cues.en: So this list of non-relevant words in the stop words list is practically always used in natural language processing because indeed these words will never help you
cues.zh: 這份停用詞清單，幾乎總在 NLP 使用，因為這些詞不會幫

cues.en: or your algorithm to classify your text, so you will most of the time use it, and therefore that's a very important step.
cues.zh: 你或演算法分類文字，大多時候會用，所以很重要。

cues.en: Because, of course, that simplifies the corpus and reduces the future sparse matrix very much.
cues.zh: 當然也大幅簡化 corpus、縮小矩陣。

cues.en: So, as I just said, this is not what we only need to input in this tmap function, we need to input a third parameter, and that corresponds to the words we want to remove.
cues.zh: 剛才說了，tm_map 不只這些，還要第三參數，對應想移除的詞。

cues.en: That is all the non-relevant words.
cues.zh: 所有無關詞。

cues.en: And these words are in this stop words function.
cues.zh: 它們在 stopwords 函式裡。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So basically, this returns all the words that are not relevant for our model, and therefore, thanks to this function here, we will remove all the words returned by this stop words function.
cues.zh: 它傳回模型無關詞，透過這個函式移除 stopwords 傳回的全部詞。

cues.en: All right, so that's all for this line of code.
cues.zh: 這行就這樣。

cues.en: But we need to add a little something.
cues.zh: 但要加點東西。

cues.en: Well, especially for you if you are doing natural language processing for the first time, which is a library that we need to install and import to be able to use this stop words function
cues.zh: 尤其第一次 NLP，需要安裝匯入一個函式庫，才能用 stopwords，

cues.en: because this function is not included in a default package of R, so we need to install the required package to use this function.
cues.zh: 因為不是 R 預設套件，要安裝所需套件。

cues.en: And this package actually has a funny name.
cues.zh: 名字有點有趣。

cues.en: It is called SnowballC.
cues.zh: SnowballC。

cues.en: And so, let's now install this package.
cues.zh: 現在安裝。

cues.en: So, we can, you know, copy this line, paste it here.
cues.zh: 複製這行貼這裡。

cues.en: And in this, quotes here in the parenthesis, we input Snowball, so it's spelled this way, Snowball, and then C.
cues.zh: 括號引號內填 Snowball，再 C，SnowballC。

cues.en: All right, so right now in some comments, but you know check in your package this list if you already have this snowball package, we never know.
cues.zh: 目前註解掉，但看看 Packages 是否已有，說不定。

cues.en: And if you don't have it, well you can execute this line without the comment to install the package.
cues.zh: 沒有就去註解，執行安裝。

cues.en: Alright, and now of course, as usual we will import the package automatically thanks to this library function.
cues.zh: 照慣例再用 library 自動匯入。

cues.en: So we will same, copy this line, paste it below, and replace TM by actually SnowballC.
cues.zh: 複製這行貼下，把 tm 換 SnowballC。

cues.en: All right, SnowballC.
cues.zh: SnowballC。

cues.en: Now the required package are installed and imported to be able to use this upwards function.
cues.zh: 所需套件已安裝匯入，能用 stopwords。

cues.en: So everything is all good.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And now let's try it on the first review.
cues.zh: 試第一則。

cues.en: Because the first review contains some irrelevant words like this here, it might be the only word that is removed because you know, wow might not be a word
cues.zh: 有 this 這種無關詞，可能只移除它，因為 wow 可能不是

cues.en: of the stop words list because you know the stop words list is a list of common words like articles and prepositions, common words but irrelevant words.
cues.zh: 停用詞；清單是冠詞、介系詞這類常見但無關詞。

cues.en: And wow is not common, so it might not be removed but definitely this will be removed because this is a common and non-relevant word.
cues.zh: wow 不常見，可能保留，但 this 常見無關，一定移除。

cues.en: So let's check it out.
cues.zh: 檢查。

cues.en: We will select this line and execute.
cues.zh: 選這行執行。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: And now let's have a look at the first review by pressing the up arrow.
cues.zh: 按向上看看第一則。

cues.en: Here it is.
cues.zh: 來了。

cues.en: Let's press enter.
cues.zh: Enter。

cues.en: And as I just said, this was removed.
cues.zh: 如所說，this 移除了。

cues.en: So now the first review becomes "well loved place".
cues.zh: 第一則變成 wow loved place。

cues.en: And you know, even if we really simplify the review, you know, now it doesn't look the same as the original review.
cues.zh: 雖然大幅簡化，與原本樣子不同，

cues.en: Well, we can still understand that it's a positive review and especially our machine learning model will understand it very well.
cues.zh: 仍懂是正面，尤其模型會理解。

cues.en: And that will be thanks to this loved word here which is a word that of course might be present in some other reviews, which themselves will be positive reviews as well.
cues.zh: 因為 loved，可能也在其他正評出現。

cues.en: So that's how our machine learning algorithm will understand that love indicates a positive review.
cues.zh: 演算法就這樣理解 love 表示正評。

cues.en: And therefore that's all it needs to establish that kind of correlations.
cues.zh: 只需要這些建立關聯。

cues.en: And this is totally unuseful and we were right to remove it.
cues.zh: this 完全無用，移除正確。

cues.en: All right, so that's done for this step.
cues.zh: 這步完成。

cues.en: That was another very important step, but that's not all.
cues.zh: 又一個重要步驟，但還沒完。

cues.en: In the next tutorial we will do another very important step which is the stemming step.
cues.zh: 下一堂另一重要步驟，詞幹提取。

cues.en: And so I'll explain you what it is and how we perform this new cleaning step in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 解釋它是什麼、如何做這個新清理步驟。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
